chunks: And God produced you from the earth like a vegetable growth;

key_terms.أَنبَتَكُمْ: You caused to grow / produced like plants

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by being 'produced from the earth like a vegetable growth'?
ai.summary: In Surah Nuh, this verse underscores the humble, earthly origin of humanity to contrast with human arrogance, serving as a potent argument for the ease of resurrection. Shia exegetes, such as Al-Tabarsi, highlight this as a rhetorical device where God reminds the disbelievers of their own creation from dust to validate the promise of return. This thematic link between earthly origin and divine power to recreate is central to the Surah's message of monotheism.
